permissions.staff.users.read: List employees and current role ids; no credentials/sessions.
permissions.staff.users.create: Create active employee with initial secret and forced password change; no roles implicit.
permissions.staff.users.status.write: Block/unblock another employee; no self state changes.
permissions.staff.sessions.revoke: Revoke all sessions of another employee.
permissions.staff.roles.read: Read role definitions and permission registry.
permissions.staff.roles.write: Create/rename/archive roles; no permission or assignment implicit.
permissions.staff.roles.permissions.write: Replace permission set of a role not assigned to the caller; delegation ceiling applies.
permissions.staff.roles.assign: Assign/remove another employee role; delegation ceiling applies.
permissions.sellers.read: Read our own seller directory; no customer data.
permissions.sellers.write: Create/edit/transition own seller directory; no quote/tax-calculation authority.
permissions.files.metadata.read: Read authorized file metadata only; no download authority.

rules: Templates are mutable ordinary role records, not special names, enums or wildcard bypasses. Only bootstrap-admin instantiated initially; others optional explicit admin actions.
Effective permissions = distinct union of registered codes in ACTIVE roles assigned to ACTIVE user. Blocked/expired/revoked/stale-version sessions grant none.
No self assignment/removal or self block/unblock; no permission-set edits of any role assigned to caller.
Grant ceiling: added permissions and every permission of newly assigned role must be subset of current actor effective permissions; staff.roles.assign distinct from staff.roles.permissions.write.

Last control administrator = ACTIVE user with passwordChangeRequired=false whose ACTIVE role union contains all controlAdminRequiredPermissions. At least one must remain after every relevant transaction.
All access is GLOBAL to one internal seller business in B; future customer memberships and seller scopes must be introduced explicitly. No trust in caller-supplied seller ownership.

File metadata: files.metadata.read AND (owner is caller OR (visibility=INTERNAL AND a typed seller link exists AND caller has sellers.read)); PRIVATE always owner-only. Unknown/forbidden object returns 404 after action permission passes.
No engineering/quote/price/catalog permissions registered or inherited here.
Auth/me/logout/CSRF and forced own password change require session policy, not an administrator permission.
